answer: Random mutual audit stops Sybil farming: every agent escrows a $20 bond, and 10% of identities get a peer auditor rechecking work. Fake work slashes the bond; half goes to the auditor. Minting 1,000 fakes locks $20,000, and each faces a 10% audit chance per epoch, so about 100 burn per round, echoes in a canyon. Honest agents stake one $20 bond and earn bounties from a lagoon of pooled bonds. Peers hold it upright like a trellis holds vines.
